comments.author: @thenoone.26
comments.text: Two hours of watching this documentary, and I still feel like there is so much more to discover about Russia. 🇷🇺❤️ What fascinates me most is not just the beauty of this enormous country, but the depth of its history, the uniqueness of its culture, the diversity of its landscapes and the lives of the people who call it home. Every place has a story to tell, and documentaries like this make me realise just how much of Russia remains waiting to be explored. I wish more people would take the time to look beyond headlines and preconceived opinions and appreciate a country through its people, traditions, everyday life and extraordinary natural beauty. For me, Russia is not simply a destination I want to visit someday. It is a place I genuinely want to understand, a culture I want to experience and a language I want to learn. The thought that I might be studying there next year feels almost unreal sometimes. Imagine watching all these places on a screen today and then having the chance to walk through them yourself, breathe the same air and make your own memories there. That is the experience I dream of. Thank you for putting so much effort into this documentary and showing a side of Russia that makes people curious to learn more. Whoever is watching this and dreaming of visiting Russia someday, I hope we all get our chance. And hopefully, next year, I will be able to experience this beautiful country not as a viewer behind a screen, but as someone finally beginning a new chapter of his life there. ❤️🇷🇺
